Lightning Talk: Navigating Code Reviews as a Code Author - Ben Deane - CppCon 2025
---

As authors of code, we want our work to get into the main line quickly and with a mininum of fuss. We can influence this process to a large extent! This lighting talk highlights some of the things we can do to make reviewers' jobs easier and make the process go more smoothly for everyone.

Ben Deane
 
Ben has been programming in C++ for this whole millennium. He spent just over 20 years in the games industry working for companies like EA and Blizzard; many of the games he worked on used to be fondly remembered but now he's accepted that they are probably mostly forgotten. After getting more interested in modern C++, in the teens he started giving internal company talks and then talks at various conference
